question: What power is attributed to the blessed goddess Kāmeśvarī in this form?
premises: Kāmeśvarī is addressed as the blessed goddess.
She is capable of attracting the three worlds.
inference: The blessed Kāmeśvarī is capable of attracting the three worlds.
plain_english: Meditate on the blessed Kāmeśvarī, who is capable of attracting the three worlds.
